control_name: Developers cannot approve or deploy their own changes
control_objective: No individual can both author and approve, or both author and deploy, a change to a financially-significant production system, enforcing segregation of duties across the change lifecycle.
risk_addressed: If a developer can approve or deploy their own change, a single individual can introduce and promote unauthorized or fraudulent logic to a financially-significant system without independent review, defeating change controls and misstating the financial statements.

required_data_elements.business_definition: A merge of a change into a protected branch, with author and approver identities.
A production deployment record with the deploying actor and the change author.

method.summary: Inspect merges to protected branches and production deployments to confirm the author is never the approver or the deployer.
steps: Pull merges to protected branches with author and approver identities from source control.
Pull production deployments with deploying actor and originating change author from the pipeline.
Flag any merge where the approver equals the author (self-approval).
Flag any deployment where the deploying actor equals the change author (self-deploy).
method.fallback_logic: If either source is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any self-approval or self-deploy to a financially-significant system is a segregation-of-duties exception.

pass_criteria: No self-approved merges to protected branches.
fail_criteria: One or more merges were approved by their author.
One or more production releases were deployed by their author.
exception_handling: Review the affected change for independent re-approval and re-test before relying on the control.

assertions.description: No self-approved merges to protected branches.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each quarter before §302 certification.

actions_on_fail: Notify Release Manager and Engineering Director
